profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer with a high bar for quality and a soft spot for the details that make an app feel good to use. Ten years at LinkedIn taught me how to ship experiences that hundreds of millions of people touch, and how much craft it takes to keep something that big feeling simple.

The thing I'm most excited about right now is AI. I build agentic systems on the side, usually in service of my own hobbies: a travel assistant that lives in WhatsApp and helps me chase award flights, and a coding agent that turns emails into pull requests. What I'm endlessly curious about is what makes them reliable enough to actually trust.

Kotlin and Android are home base; I wander happily into Python, TypeScript, and whatever else the problem needs.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Tech Lead for Pages Member Experience (the member-facing surfaces of LinkedIn Company Pages), setting technical direction for the team and leading its migration to a Server-Driven UI platform

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Launched several user facing features across Pages Member and Admin experiences
- Owned the end-to-end Play Store release process for LinkedIn Elevate Android app; led architecture migration from MVC to MVVM
- Drove Kotlin and Jetpack Compose adoption org-wide, establishing modern Android development best practices

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Joined as Android Engineer #3 on Pages team; launched Company Page Admin and the redesigned Pages experience on Android.
